definitions.explanation: The art of organized sound; can refer to music in general or a specific piece of music.

examples.japanese: {音楽|おんがく}を{聞|き}いています。
どんな{音楽|おんがく}が{好|す}きですか。
examples.english: What kind of music do you like?

examples.japanese: {音楽|おんがく}の{先生|せんせい}になりたいです。
examples.english: I want to become a music teacher.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どものころから{音楽|おんがく}が{大好|だいす}きでした。
examples.english: I've loved music since I was a child.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}の{中|なか}で{音楽|おんがく}を{聞|き}いていると、{時間|じかん}がすぐ{過|す}ぎる。
examples.english: When I listen to music on the train, time passes quickly.

notes:
{音楽|おんがく} combines {音|おと} (sound) and {楽|がく} (pleasure/music).

Related words:
- {音楽家|おんがくか} (ongakuka, musician)
- {音楽会|おんがくかい} (ongakukai, concert). Used with {聞|き}く (to listen) rather than {見|み}る (to see).
